rows.grounds: compound epithet: ratikānta (lord of Rati/pleasure, Kāma) + stutā (praised); feminine nominative singular describing the goddess
epithet denoting a mass or collection; feminine nominative singular in apposition
compound epithet: rāśi (heap/mass) + rakṣaṇa (protection) + kāriṇī (doer); feminine nominative singular

items.question: What attributes of praise and protective power are ascribed to the goddess in this enumeration?
premises: The goddess is described as praised by the lord of pleasure.
The goddess is identified as a heap or mass.
The goddess is characterized as the protector of heaps.
items.inference: The goddess embodies both the honor of being praised by Kāma and the power to constitute and safeguard collective masses.
uncertainties: The precise referent of rāśi (heap/mass) is context-dependent and not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: She is praised by the lord of pleasure, she is a heap, and she is the protector of heaps.
